dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.prototype: Exact source geometry association retained; no named prototype is assigned here.

prototype_evidence.physical_model: source finite neutral scalar EPC; no SOC transfer certificate

candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: Lu target improves source lambda and Tc against Sc and Hf frozen controls; TiZr3 has lower lambda but higher Tc. This demonstrates that omega_log and electronic/mass changes must accompany lambda, and avoids ranking raw lambda as universally superior. All target forces zero; order/disorder and low-energy competing alloy phase remain untested.
candidate.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.0 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.001 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.
candidate.route_response: Sc/Hf-to-Lu minority-role construction in Zr3X cubic order. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
candidate.next_action: Inspect existing Zr-network mode/active-state changes for Lu/Sc/Hf and retain Ti counterexample. Favorable: a matched paired benefit on ordered branch survives refinement; adverse: order or phonon scale benefit disappears; ambiguous: no phase-ordering distinction.

seven_criteria.identity: Exact source CIF/SCF/Γ state association; CIF source record 8313. Experimental occupancy/P/T and physical magnetic ground state remain unknown; source scalar model only.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Sc/Hf-to-Lu minority-role construction in Zr3X cubic order. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: direct published source EPC and independent source isotropic Eliashberg result. 2 favorable comparator(s); bounded source model, not experiment.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.0 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.001 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: Lu target improves source lambda and Tc against Sc and Hf frozen controls; TiZr3 has lower lambda but higher Tc. This demonstrates that omega_log and electronic/mass changes must accompany lambda, and avoids ranking raw lambda as universally superior. All target forces zero; order/disorder and low-energy competing alloy phase remain untested.
seven_criteria.novelty: Exact Zr3Lu ordered search found no primary experimental exact SC phase. SG221 Zr3Lu differs from ordinary Zr-rich solid solution and from source ScZr3/Hf variants; known chemistry does not establish same-phase alias.
seven_criteria.decision: Inspect existing Zr-network mode/active-state changes for Lu/Sc/Hf and retain Ti counterexample. Favorable: a matched paired benefit on ordered branch survives refinement; adverse: order or phonon scale benefit disappears; ambiguous: no phase-ordering distinction.

candidate.newness_scope: New to the reviewed candidate mechanism catalogue, source prediction already published; not first discovery.
